title: Sea's View on the Future of Agentic Software Development with Codex
summary: Sea Limited's CPO explains why the company is deploying Codex across engineering teams to accelerate AI-native software development in Asia.
body: Sea Limited's CPO explains why the company is deploying Codex across engineering teams to accelerate AI-native software development in Asia.
summaryZh: Sea Limited首席产品官分享了公司部署Codex以加速AI原生软件开发的愿景。通过将AI代理集成至工程团队，公司旨在提升开发效率并推动软件工程向智能化转型。

aiReview.reasonZh: 探讨了AI Agent在软件开发生命周期中的应用趋势，对行业开发模式具有参考意义。
